description:
MAIN-PARA's EIBCALEN = 0 guard at app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:80-83 - the first-ever invocation of transaction CC00, typed at a clear screen with no communication area. In source order the program executes SET ERR-FLG-OFF TO TRUE at :75, MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COSGN0AO at :77-78, finds IF EIBCALEN = 0 true at :80, clears the whole output map with MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COSGN0AO at :81, positions the cursor with MOVE -1 TO USERIDL OF COSGN0AI at :82, performs SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN at :83 - which runs POPULATE-HEADER-INFO (:147) and then MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO (:149) before the single SEND MAP at :151-157 - and leaves through EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(WS-TRANID) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) at :98-102. That is why termination is RETURN_TRANSID and not XCTL: the only XCTL in this program is at :231-239, reachable solely from the true branch of the plaintext password comparison at :223.

No file read occurs. READ-USER-SEC-FILE (:209-219) sits inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, which this path never performs, so the ten seeded USRSEC rows are present and untouched. They are declared anyway because they are the canonical block case02 through case20 reuse verbatim. expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion that nothing was written anywhere, and expectedFinalState pins all ten rows so that no observed row is left unaccounted for; expectedDatasets adds the dataset-level assertion that USRSEC holds exactly ten rows at an 80-byte layout on the FINAL_STATE channel.

USERIDO and PASSWDO are LOW-VALUES - X'00', written here as the explicit \u0000 escape eight times - and emphatically not spaces, X'20'. MOVE LOW-VALUES TO COSGN0AO at :81 clears the entire redefined output area, and POPULATE-HEADER-INFO repopulates only the six header items plus the two EXEC CICS ASSIGN targets; nothing on this path puts spaces into the two credential-entry items. BMS does not transmit a field whose data is X'00', so a screen cleared to LOW-VALUES and one cleared to spaces do not look the same at the terminal. ERRMSGO is 78 spaces because WS-MESSAGE was SPACES at :77 when :149 moved it, and MOVE WS-MESSAGE TO ERRMSGO truncates the 80-byte working-storage field to the symbolic map's PIC X(78).

The cursor is response metadata, never a payload member: MOVE -1 TO USERIDL is an instruction to CICS rather than data, so it is carried as cursorField USERIDL and the xxxL, xxxF and xxxA items appear nowhere among the fields. app/bms/COSGN00.bms:156 corroborates it - USERID DFHMDF ATTRB=(FSET,IC,NORM,UNPROT), where IC is the insertion cursor.

expectedMessages is empty because grep -c DISPLAY over app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl is 0: this program emits no line at all, and the 80-byte WS-MESSAGE is observable only as the 78-byte ERRMSGO of the send above. expectedReturnCode is 0 because grep -c RETURN-CODE over the same file is likewise 0 - COSGN00C never manipulates it, unlike CSUTLDTC, so no case for this program may claim a non-zero code.

The navigation context is asserted exactly as the source leaves it, which on this path is untouched. COSGN00C populates CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, CDEMO-USER-ID, CDEMO-USER-TYPE and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT only on the successful-authentication path at :224-228, and sets none of them here, yet :98-102 still hands the area back - so every alphanumeric span is spaces and every PIC 9 span is zeros, which is what SignOnService returns as NavigationContext.empty(). Three members are deliberately absent for the same reason. nextProgram is absent because no XCTL happens. nextMapset and nextMap are absent because COSGN00C never writes CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET or CDEMO-LAST-MAP - grep returns zero occurrences of both - so the commarea carries seven spaces in each rather than a name, and the mapset COSGN00 and map COSGN0A are invariant constants of the program rather than components of its outcome. And no aid is declared, because EIBAID is read only at :85, inside the ELSE branch this path never enters; naming a key would suggest the key mattered.

Determinism. POPULATE-HEADER-INFO opens with MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA at :179, so the clock is pinned rather than read: 2022-07-19T23:12:33, traceable to this program's own version footer at :259, and expressed as a fixed local date-time so no timezone can shift it. Derived through app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy, WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY is MM '/' DD '/' YY with YY taken from WS-CURDATE-YEAR(3:2), giving CURDATEO exactly 07/19/22 at its declared PIC X(8); WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS is HH ':' MM ':' SS, eight bytes, moved into CURTIMEO which app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY:122 declares PIC X(9) - hence 23:12:33 followed by exactly one trailing space. Note that width: the sibling COUSR02 map declares its CURTIMEO PIC X(8), and the two must not be conflated.

APPLID and SYSID are a documented substitution rather than a derivation. They come from EXEC CICS ASSIGN at :198-204, which has no Java equivalent, and neither application.yml nor application-test.yml binds an applid or a sysid; CICSAWS1 and AWS1 (space-padded to the map's PIC X(8)) are therefore pinned test-profile constants standing in for those two ASSIGN calls, and every one of this program's twenty cases uses the same pair. The substitution is stated here rather than hidden.

Record geometry, summed mechanically from app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:18-23 so a reviewer can check it by eye: SEC-USR-ID X(08) at 0, SEC-USR-FNAME X(20) at 8, SEC-USR-LNAME X(20) at 28, SEC-USR-PWD X(08) at 48, SEC-USR-TYPE X(01) at 56, which is 57 - then SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) at 57, which is 80. The seed rows are declared at their literal 57 characters, exactly as app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 carries them, and the 23-byte shortfall is supplied once at seed time by the declared USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation; they are never hand-padded here. The same job corroborates the target width twice, with DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) on SYSUT2 and RECORDSIZE(80,80) KEYS(8,0) on the cluster definition. SEC-USR-FILLER is a named data item whose name merely contains the word FILLER, not COBOL's anonymous FILLER, and the 80-character expectedBytes images below prove it was emitted as 23 spaces: a record missing that span would be short by exactly 23. Every password is the literal PASSWORD, eight characters filling PIC X(08) with no padding, and it stays plaintext because :223 compares it in plaintext - transforming that span in any way would change observable behaviour. The dataset is addressed by its binding key USRSEC and never by a dataset name.

Two verified deviations, documented rather than silently ignored or silently corrected. First, app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:59 is *COPY DFHATTR. with the asterisk in column 7, which makes it a COBOL comment: no DFHATTR constant is in effect for this program, so none is named anywhere in this case. Second, COSGN00C does not copy CSSETATY at all - its only consumer is COACTUPC - so there is no runtime DFHRED-plus-asterisk field highlight here; grep returns zero occurrences of CSSETATY, ERRMSGC and DFHRED in this program, which is why attributes is empty. The red emphasis on the error line is a static map property, declared once at app/bms/COSGN00.bms:197-200 as ERRMSG DFHMDF ATTRB=(ASKIP,BRT,FSET) COLOR=RED LENGTH=78 POS=(23,1). SignOnService's dependency list confirms both independently: it takes neither FieldAttributeSetter nor BmsAttributes.

Provenance. Every expected value above is statically derived - by structured reading of app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl cross-checked against the copybooks app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy, COCOM01Y.cpy, COTTL01Y.cpy, CSDAT01Y.cpy and CSMSG01Y.cpy, the symbolic map app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY, the mapset app/bms/COSGN00.bms, the transaction definition at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:378-379 and the ten seed rows of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44. It was never captured from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand.

The unit is SignOnService, driven directly as a plain object - no MockMvc, no HTTP, no servlet container and no JobLauncher in the path - and all conversation state travels in the payload, so no server-side session exists to hold any of it. This case is the first-entry half of the ENTER/REENTER pair; the re-entry half is supplied by its siblings. Neither the backward-GO TO restructuring gate nor the abend gate applies to this program: grep -c "GO TO" and grep -c CEE3ABD over app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl are both 0, and neither is faked here.
